I think this may be remembered as one of the greatest Doctor Who episodes of all time, providing Moffat can stick the landing in next weeks season finale... and I've been a Doctor Who fan since the days of Tom Baker.

This episode featured legitimate science fiction (the time dilation was implemented spectacularly), story twists, suspenseful and creepy moments and key characters.

I've always thought that Peter Capaldi could have been the best version of the Doctor if only he wasn't given asinine scripts to work with, but now I am hopeful that at least his portrayal may be done some justice.
